questions.question: In which year did the United States record the highest total number of births?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_births_fertility_rates_us.csv')
result = str(df.loc[df['Birth Number'].idxmax(), 'Year'])

questions.question: Did the general fertility rate in the United States ever drop below 60 births per 1,000 women between 1909 and 2018?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_births_fertility_rates_us.csv')
result = 'yes' if (df['General Fertility Rate'] < 60).any() else 'no'

questions.question: How many fewer live births were recorded in the United States in 2017 compared to 2007?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_births_fertility_rates_us.csv')
b_2007 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2007, 'Birth Number'].values[0]
b_2017 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2017, 'Birth Number'].values[0]
result = int(b_2007 - b_2017)

questions.question: What was the average crude birth rate in the United States from 1920 through 1929?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_births_fertility_rates_us.csv')
decade = df[(df['Year'] >= 1920) & (df['Year'] <= 1929)]
result = round(float(decade['Crude Birth Rate'].mean()), 2)
